analysis.expected: All-up Q8_0 CPU-compatible skip would remove decode CPU up fallback while preserving token-level correctness.
analysis.observed_gap: The path is correct but slower: eval_tok_s dropped from 4.4 to 1.8 and TTFT rose by 5375.354156 ms over accepted SOTA.
likely_causes: Per-call CPU-compatible Q8_0 CUDA work is too fine-grained; 18688 skipped up calls add launch/sync/D2H/scatter overhead.
The remaining down projection still uses CPU fallback and source/page behavior, so up-only offload cannot remove the full fallback bottleneck.
CPU time increased to 22min 2.992s, indicating the current skip path still adds substantial host-side overhead instead of reducing total work.
analysis.next_step: Do not rerun this same benchmark. Write q80-upskip-overhead-localization-plan.json and add default-off timing counters to break down quantization, CUDA kernel, D2H/scatter/sync, launch overhead, down fallback, and source/page time.
